Cache directory, cache management and credentials

Source: R/cache.R
ntl_cache_dir.Rd

ntl_cache_dir() returns the folder where downloaded tiles, LAADS listings and manifests are stored. By default this is a temporary folder that is deleted when the R session ends, so nothing is left on disk unless you ask for it. To keep downloads between sessions, set a permanent folder in one of two ways:

  • add NTLPANEL_CACHE=/path/to/folder to ~/.Renviron (tools::R_user_dir("ntlpanel", "cache") is a good choice), or

  • set options(ntlpanel.cache_dir = "/path/to/folder") in a script.

Usage

ntl_cache_dir(create = TRUE)

ntl_cache_info(cache_dir = ntl_cache_dir(create = FALSE))

ntl_cache_clear(
  manifest = NULL,
  all = FALSE,
  cache_dir = ntl_cache_dir(create = FALSE)
)

ntl_token(required = TRUE)

Arguments

create

Create the directory if it does not exist.

cache_dir

Cache directory to inspect or clear.

manifest

A manifest returned by ntl_fetch() or ntl_files().

all

Delete everything in the cache directory.

required

If TRUE, error when no token is set.

Value

ntl_cache_dir() returns a path. ntl_cache_info() returns a one-row data frame with path, n_files and size_mb. ntl_cache_clear() returns the number of deleted files, invisibly. ntl_token() returns the token as a string ("" if unset and required = FALSE).

Details

ntl_cache_info() reports how much space the cache uses. ntl_cache_clear() deletes the files listed in a manifest, which lets you process large areas period by period without keeping every .h5 file, or with all = TRUE empties the whole cache.

ntl_token() returns the NASA Earthdata bearer token from the EARTHDATA_TOKEN environment variable. Generate a token at https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov (Generate Token) and store it in ~/.Renviron as EARTHDATA_TOKEN=...; never hard-code it in scripts.

Examples

old <- options(ntlpanel.cache_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "ntl-cache"))
ntl_cache_dir()
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpUCRD7M/ntl-cache"
ntl_cache_info()
#>                        path n_files size_mb
#> 1 /tmp/RtmpUCRD7M/ntl-cache       0       0
ntl_cache_clear(all = TRUE)
options(old)
